title: Mirror Distance of an Integer
summary: Given an integer n, calculate its mirror distance by finding the absolute difference between n and its digit-reversed counterpart.
statement: Given an integer n, calculate its mirror distance by finding the absolute difference between n and its digit-reversed counterpart. Return this difference.
constraints: Reverse the decimal digits of n, dropping any leading zeros created in the reversed form.
Return the absolute difference between n and that reversed integer.
A decimal palindrome therefore has distance zero.
hints: Convert n to decimal text and reverse it.
Integer parsing removes any new leading zeros.
Absolute value makes the distance independent of which integer is larger.
editorial: Absolute value makes the distance independent of which integer is larger.

tests.explanation: The reverse is 52, whose absolute difference from 25 is 27.
The reverse is 21, so the distance is 99.
